title: Why a 10-Minute Fix Took 10 Days | DevOps & SRE Zero to Hero Day 2
description:
Why did a 10-minute fix take 10 days to reach users? Day 2 walks through the old release process, the wall between Dev and Ops, how DevOps was born in 2008-2009, and builds a tiny deploy script that stops on failure.

I'm Shivam Singh Verma, a DevOps & SRE engineer with 5 years of experience building CI/CD pipelines, running cloud infrastructure on AWS & GCP, and managing projects.

📺 Day 2 of 100 · DevOps & SRE Zero to Hero: a free course with a new episode every day at 8 PM IST.

🔑 What you'll learn
• Where the 10 days went: hand-offs and queues
• The wall of confusion between Dev and Ops
• Why big batches make releases risky
• How DevOps was born (Agile, Flickr, DevOpsDays)
• Pipelines and the 4 DORA metrics
• A deploy script with set -e that stops on failure
• A real CVE patching story: days to hours with Jenkins
• A 20-second interview answer
